item.title: CHCC’s $30M debt to CUC may take 17 years to clear
item.description: THE Commonwealth Healthcare Corp. will be able to pay off its arrears in approximately 17 years if the hospital stays current on its bills and consistently meets its minimum monthly payments, Assistant Attorney General Tina Ngo said in a recent status report to the federal court. item.title: UPDATE: US and Israel strike Iran, targeting its top leaders
item.description: An Israeli official said Iranian Supreme Leader Ayatollah Ali Khamenei and President Masoud Pezeshkian were both targeted but the result of the strikes was not clear. A source with knowledge of the matter had earlier told Reuters that Khamenei was not in Tehran and had been transferred to a secure location. item.title: Iran’s supreme leader has been killed during major attack, Trump says
item.description: DUBAI, United Arab Emirates (AP) — A major attack launched by Israel and the United States killed Iran’s Supreme Leader Ayatollah Ali Khamenei, President Donald Trump announced Saturday, confirming an assassination that he said gave Iranians their “greatest chance” to “take back the country” but that also put the future of the Islamic Republic in doubt and raised the risk of regional instability.
